scope: Five suppliers and five regulator-documented projects, selected for accessible primary evidence. Not a complete verification of Atomic Atlas.
provenance: Atomic Atlas did not expose row citations. These are independently located corroborating or correcting sources, not a claim about sources used by its author.

records.name: Japan Steel Works
records.supported_statement: JSW describes forged reactor-vessel shell flanges and monoblock forgings.
records.limits: Do not import the claimed >600t vessel-head weight or customer list without separate evidence. Ingots, presses and finished components have different weight measures. Search-indexed primary-source text was available, but direct retrieval returned 403 and the browser check did not confirm the product text. Recheck the live source before publication.

records.name: Doosan Enerbility
records.supported_statement: NuScale disclosed a December 20, 2024 task order to Doosan for long-lead materials for six upper reactor pressure vessels.
records.limits: Historical agreement evidence; does not prove present spare capacity, finished delivery, current lead times or project operation. Avoid carrying forward the 2022 UAMPS schedule.

records.name: BWXT
records.claim_checked: Reactor pressure vessel, steam generator and heat exchanger capability
records.supported_statement: BWXT describes engineering and manufacturing reactor pressure vessels, steam generators and heat exchangers.
records.limits: Does not independently establish every Atomic Atlas customer relationship. A corporate component capability is not the same entity as the existing BWXT fuel facility in Atlas.

records.name: Framatome
records.claim_checked: Le Creusot nuclear forgings and castings
records.supported_statement: Framatome describes Le Creusot manufacturing forged or cast parts under nuclear quality regulations for civil and naval reactors.
records.limits: This is historical capability evidence. Header and body dates differ within December 2020; retain month precision. Full current Saint-Marcel scope, customer list and capacity need further verification. A searched steam-generator product-sheet URL returned 404 and is excluded as an accepted source.

records.name: Sheffield Forgemasters
records.supported_statement: Company announcement describes nuclear-grade castings/forgings and signed civil nuclear MOUs with Rolls-Royce SMR and other named developers.

primary_source.locator: Expanded Holtec MoU and final civil nuclear MOUs paragraph

records.limits: Record relationships as MOUs, not delivered orders, qualified production capacity or guaranteed future revenue. Royal Navy relationship not verified in this source.

records.name: Dow Seadrift / Long Mott
records.supported_statement: NRC records receipt of a construction permit application on March 31, 2025, and acceptance for docketing on May 12, 2025.

primary_source.locator: Document-register rows for receipt and docketing

records.limits: Replace the Atomic Atlas early-site-permit label. Application receipt and docketing are not permit issuance; do not import its target operation date.

records.name: Clinch River BWRX-300
records.supported_statement: NRC describes ongoing construction-permit review; its milestone table labels the decision Fall 2026 as a target. An early site permit was issued in 2019.

primary_source.locator: Project Overview; Key Milestones: Construction Permit Decision

records.limits: Atomic Atlas approval wording is unsupported for the construction permit by the inspected regulator page. Keep early-site permit, excavation exemptions and construction permit distinct. Check the docket immediately before any status publication.

records.name: Natrium / Kemmerer Unit 1
records.supported_statement: NRC records issuance of construction permit CPAR-1 to US SFR Owner on March 9, 2026.

primary_source.locator: NRC Issues Construction Permit to US SFR Owner

records.limits: Atomic Atlas non-nuclear-construction wording omits the later licensing milestone. This permit does not authorize operation or establish its 2030 completion target.

records.name: Darlington New Nuclear
records.supported_statement: CNSC records an April 2025 licence to construct one BWRX-300 reactor; the inspected page lists one unit under construction.

primary_source.locator: Current status; April 2025 construction licence; Facility information

records.limits: One licensed unit must not become four licensed units. An application to operate is not an operating licence. The Atomic Atlas target year remains unverified.

records.name: Kairos Hermes
records.supported_statement: NRC records a December 14, 2023 construction permit for Hermes, a 35 MWth test reactor that will not generate electricity.
records.limits: Keep Hermes separate from Hermes 2 and the commercial KP-FHR design. Do not convert thermal power to electric output or import the target demo year. NRC identifies application docket 05007513.
